_comment: This is a TEMPLATE, not a working config — the IPs below are documentation-only placeholders (RFC 5737 TEST-NET ranges, guaranteed never to be real). Do not point --proxies-config at this file as-is. Instead run ./configure-proxies.sh, which asks for your real proxies and tests SSH to each one before writing a working file with this same shape.

_fields.id: short stable id used in URLs and alert tags
_fields.name: label shown in the dropdown
_fields.ssh: user@host:/path/to/access.log  — or host:2222:/path for a non-standard SSH port
_fields.log: use instead of ssh for a local or mounted log file
_fields.udp_port: use instead of ssh to receive access_log udp:// pushes
_fields.tcp_port: use instead of ssh to receive access_log tcp:// pushes
_fields.squid_host: host to poll for cache-manager stats (defaults to the ssh host)
_fields.key: private key file for this proxy (defaults to --ssh-key)
_fields.sudo: true to run the remote tail via sudo -n (needs NOPASSWD)
_fields.admin: false = monitor only, the UI cannot change policy/blocklist on it
_fields.enabled: false to skip this proxy entirely
